fieldNotes.truckGate: Two black sliding gates with continuous wrought-iron perimeter fencing across the wide truck driveway off Beachey Place, confirmed in 2025-03 Street View.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No standalone guard booth structure beside the gate in satellite z20 or Street View; entrance has only a monument sign and a blue check-in/kiosk post inside the gate.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Controlled gate present but unstaffed - implies kiosk/call-box/app check-in.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks on two distinct building faces (east face ~20-24 doors, west face ~15-18 doors) operating as separate clusters.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide gate apron and deep internal yard drive provide unused paved width for a bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Estimated ~40 total (24 east + 16 west) from z19 imagery; counted as a band.
fieldNotes.entryExitTogether: Single gated entrance on the south face serves both entry and exit.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide paved yard inside the gate before the dock faces can hold trucks.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense Watson industrial park within the Los Angeles/Carson metro fabric.
